title: Cessna 210 N Centurion — Normal Operating Procedures
description: Normal operating procedures for the Cessna 210 N Centurion with Continental TSIO-520 turbocharged engine, constant-speed propeller, and retractable tricycle gear. Covers preflight walk-around through shutdown and securing. All airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, manifold pressure limits, and performance data must come from the specific aircraft POH. Turbocharged engine requires particular attention to power management; retractable gear requires a gear check on every approach. Not a substitute for qualified instruction or type-specific training.

source.notes: No manufacturer document consulted. Written from general familiarity with the type.

known_issues.description: Contains no airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, manifold pressure limits, or other numerical limitations — all must come from the specific aircraft POH.
Equipment and avionics vary widely across 210 N airframes. Verify every item against the specific aircraft and its POH before use.

rights.notes: Manufacturer POH remains under copyright. This file does not reproduce its wording or selection of items.
